mafia.title: Eliminate the Town
mafia.body: Work with your fellow Mafia at night to pick off the Town. Blend in during the day so no one figures out who you are.

detective.title: Uncover the Mafia
detective.body: Investigate one player each night to learn their true role. Use what you find to guide the Town's votes without exposing yourself too early.

doctor.title: Protect the Innocent
doctor.body: Choose one player to save each night. You won't always know who's in danger, so trust your read of the day's discussion.

civilian.title: Find the Mafia
civilian.body: You have no special power — just your voice and your vote. Pay attention, ask questions, and help the Town vote out the Mafia before it's too late.

bodyguard.title: Shield Your Target
bodyguard.body: Guard one player each night. If they're attacked, you'll take the hit for them — so choose carefully, it could cost you your life.

vigilante.title: Take Justice Into Your Hands
vigilante.body: You have a limited number of bullets. Use them to shoot someone you believe is Mafia — but if you're wrong, the guilt will cost you.

mayor.title: Lead the Town
mayor.body: Your vote counts double once revealed — but revealing yourself also makes you a target. Decide when the moment is right.

jester.title: Get Yourself Voted Out
jester.body: You win the moment the Town votes you out. Act suspicious, stir up doubt, and convince everyone you're the threat.

loop.title: The Basic Loop
loop.body: Mafia Verse alternates between Night (special roles act in secret) and Day (everyone discusses, then votes to eliminate someone). The game ends when one side wins.

mafia.title: Mafia
mafia.body: Each night, the Mafia secretly choose one player to eliminate. They win once they equal or outnumber the remaining town.

detective.title: Detective
detective.body: Each night, check one player to learn if they're Mafia. Use what you learn to guide the town's votes without giving away that you're the Detective.

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.body: Each night, protect one player from the Mafia's kill. You can protect yourself, but think carefully about who really needs saving.

civilian.title: Civilian
civilian.body: You have no night ability, but your vote and voice matter most during the Day — listen closely and help the town find the Mafia.

bodyguard.title: Bodyguard
bodyguard.body: Each night, guard one player. If the Mafia targets your guarded player, you take the hit and die protecting them instead.

vigilante.title: Vigilante
vigilante.body: You get 2 bullets for the whole game. Any night, you may shoot a player you suspect. Shoot an innocent, though, and the guilt catches up with you.

mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.body: Once per game, reveal yourself to double your vote's weight — but doing so also tells the Mafia exactly who you are.

jester.title: Jester
jester.body: You want to get voted out! If the town votes you out during the Day, you win instantly and the game ends right there.

vote.title: The Day Vote
vote.body: After discussion, everyone votes for who to eliminate. The player with the most votes is voted out — ties mean no one goes.

overview.whatIsMafiaDescription: Mafia is a social deduction game. The Mafia secretly work together to eliminate the Town at night, while everyone else tries to figure out who they are before it's too late.
overview.theTownDescription: Detectives, Doctors, Bodyguards, Vigilantes, Mayors, and Civilians — all working to find and eliminate the Mafia.
overview.theMafiaDescription: Secretly eliminates one Town member each night, trying to reach parity with the Town before being caught.
overview.theJesterDescription: A solo trickster with one goal: get voted out by the Town during the Day.
overview.townWinsDescription: when every Mafia member has been eliminated.
overview.mafiaWinsDescription: when the Mafia equal or outnumber the remaining Town.
overview.jesterWinsDescription: the instant the Town votes them out — everyone else loses that round.
overview.difference1: A Bodyguard who can take a bullet for someone else, dying in their place.
overview.difference2: A Vigilante with only 2 bullets for the whole game — use them wisely.
overview.difference3: A Mayor who can reveal for double vote power, at the cost of being exposed.
overview.difference4: A Jester who wins by getting voted out on purpose.
overview.difference5: Real-time votes, chat, and a graveyard chat for eliminated players.
overview.jesterNoteDescription: The Jester isn't Town or Mafia — they're only trying to get themselves voted out. If it works, they win instantly and the game ends right there, regardless of what anyone else was trying to do.
overview.afkFlagDescription: That yellow flag on a player's card isn't a "suspicious" marker — it reports someone as AFK/inactive. It doesn't affect the game itself, but if a player collects 2+ reports in a game, it's logged against their account's activity record. Tap the flag again to undo a report you made by mistake.

mafia.title: Mafia
mafia.desc: Works with fellow Mafia members to secretly eliminate the Town each night.
abilities: Each night, vote with other Mafia members on who to eliminate
Can see and chat privately with other Mafia members
Wins when the Mafia equal or outnumber the remaining Town

detective.title: Detective
detective.desc: Investigates one player each night to learn their true allegiance.
abilities: Each night, check one player to learn if they're Mafia
Instantly ends the game in the Town's favor if a checked Mafia member is caught
Should share findings carefully — revealing too early makes you a target

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.desc: Protects one player each night from the Mafia's kill.
abilities: Each night, choose one player to protect from elimination
Can protect themselves, but not the same person every single night is often predictable
Doesn't know who the Mafia is targeting — protection is a guess

civilian.title: Civilian
civilian.desc: No special ability — just sharp eyes, good instincts, and a vote.
abilities: No night action — contributes entirely through discussion and voting
Wins alongside the rest of the Town when all Mafia are eliminated
Often the majority of the Town — numbers matter in the vote

bodyguard.title: Bodyguard
bodyguard.desc: Guards one player each night, taking the hit in their place if targeted.
abilities: Each night, choose one player to guard
If the Mafia targets the guarded player, the Bodyguard dies instead of them
Doesn't know who the Mafia is targeting — guarding is a guess, same as the Doctor

vigilante.title: Vigilante
vigilante.desc: A Town member with a gun and only 2 bullets for the whole game.
abilities: Starts the game with exactly 2 bullets — no more, ever
Any night, may choose to shoot one player instead of passing
Shooting an innocent player brings guilt that catches up with the Vigilante later

mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.desc: A Town leader who can reveal themselves for a stronger vote.
abilities: Once per game, can reveal their identity to the whole town
After revealing, their vote counts double for the rest of the game
Revealing also tells the Mafia exactly who to target next

jester.title: Jester
jester.desc: Plays for neither Town nor Mafia — only wants to be voted out.
abilities: Wins instantly and ends the game if voted out during the Day
Not aligned with Town or Mafia — has their own separate win condition
Best strategy is often acting suspicious enough to get votes, without being too obvious

flow.day1Description: everyone talks openly, shares suspicions, and defends themselves.
flow.day2Description: each living player votes for who they think should be eliminated.
flow.day3Description: the player with the most votes is voted out and their role may be revealed.
flow.night1Description: chooses a player to guard for the night.
flow.night2Description: secretly agree on a player to eliminate.
flow.night3Description: may choose to shoot a suspected player.
flow.night4Description: chooses a player to protect from the Mafia's kill.
flow.night5Description: investigates a player to learn if they're Mafia.
flow.night6Description: the night's events play out and everyone learns what happened when Day begins.
flow.tieBreakingDescription: If the vote ends in a tie between two or more players, no one is eliminated that day and the game moves on to Night.

townTips: Track who's been quiet during discussion — silence can be as telling as an accusation.
Watch for players who are quick to accuse others without much reasoning behind it.
If you're the Detective, don't reveal your findings too early — you'll become the Mafia's next target.
Coordinate votes as a group late in the Day rather than committing too early.
mafiaTips: Blend in during discussion — agree with the Town sometimes to avoid suspicion.
Consider voting out quieter players to protect yourselves from scrutiny.
Don't defend your fellow Mafia too aggressively — it can give away the connection.
If a Detective seems close to finding you, make eliminating them a priority.
jesterTips: Act a little suspicious on purpose — you want the Town's votes, not their trust.
Don't overdo it early, or you'll get eliminated Night 1 by the Mafia instead of voted out by the Town.
If people are defending you, that's bad for you — steer suspicion back onto yourself.
A well-timed contradiction in your own story can be exactly what gets you voted out.
redFlags: Deflecting a direct question instead of answering it
Being unusually quiet right after a fellow player is accused
Overly aggressive accusations with little actual reasoning
Voting patterns that consistently protect the same players
